units.function: Intended PostgreSQL tests for system-document visibility, document locks and non-destructive fork-on-lock behavior.
units.dependencyDirection: Vitest -> document service -> real documents/revisions/issue-document schema and embedded PostgreSQL when supported; no route authorization, Identity, evidence retention or external storage.
units.keyDataModels: Issue document key/title/format/body/latest revision, system continuation-summary key, lock time/user and redirected locked-document lineage returned on fallback creation.
units.lifecycle: Create canonical and system documents -> hide system entries from default projection -> optionally lock canonical document -> reject updates or create a new keyed document -> unlock then update exact latest revision.
units.testAssessment: All 4 tests skipped in sandboxed and approved unsandboxed runs. The intended visibility/lock/fork behavior is clear, but persistence is unverified here and tests omit authorization, lock leases/ownership, base-revision conflicts, concurrent operations, revision immutability, content safety and retention.
units.designRationale: Keep internal handoff documents out of ordinary UI lists and preserve a locked review artifact while allowing work to continue in a separate document instead of destructively overwriting it.
units.companyOsProblem: Company OS needs versioned evidence/documents with classified visibility, accountable authors, immutable lineage, review locks/leases and explicit fork/merge outcomes tied to Work and responsibility contracts.
units.companyOsFit: ADAPT system-document classification, optimistic revision identity and non-destructive fork intent. Require explicit read capability for system documents, versioned lock leases with owner/authority/expiry, content hashes, immutable revision authorship, fork reason/approval/lineage and merge/retire workflow. Bind each evidence document to Work/Agent/accountable human/data grants and retention policy.
units.responsibilityConflict: A locked canonical plan can be bypassed by creating plan-2 without a creator or accountable-human decision in the test. Locks and hidden system documents are storage/UI states, not responsibility contracts, and direct retrieval may reveal handoff content without explicit evidence/data authority.
evidence: 2026-08-19 sandboxed and approved unsandboxed focused Vitest: all 4 embedded-PostgreSQL tests skipped
units.securityFindings: CRITICAL verification gap: all persistence tests skipped. HIGH authorization gap: system document direct fetch and unlock ownership/authority are not tested; unlock is invoked without actor/lock token at service level. HIGH review-bypass risk: create_new_document can route around a locked canonical artifact without tested human approval, immutable lineage or merge policy. Missing lock expiry/stale recovery, concurrent lock/unlock/fork, base-revision conflict, cross-tenant access, content hash/size/XSS and legal retention tests.
